subject: Telemetry gap detected — initial notice & requested evidence export
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@pinebrook.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry gap detected — initial notice & requested evidence export

Alex —

Quick heads up: during routine telemetry aggregation we detected a ~3 hour gap in our request/response logging for your tenant (tenant ID: pinebrook-prod-9). The window is 2028-04-21 22:00:00 UTC — 2028-04-22 01:00:00 UTC. We’re treating this as an operational incident and I wanted to notify you immediately while we collect evidence.

What we’re doing now:
- Prioritizing a full export of all telemetry for that window (request traces, proxy logs, KV cache metrics).
- Preserving the impacted host images and container logs in an encrypted snapshot.
- Running an integrity check on our logging pipeline to identify root cause (ingest backlog vs write-fail).

Requested from Pinebrook:
- Can you confirm whether your team observed any anomalies or customer impact during that window?
- If you require a specific preservation policy (longer retention for legal/forensics), let me know — default snapshot will be retained for 90 days.

Deliverables timeline (initial):
- Evidence index + logs export (encrypted ZIP): ETA by 2028-04-22 17:00 UTC (we’ll send a secure link).
- Forensics call (30–45 min): propose 2028-04-22 20:00 UTC — please confirm availability.

Attachments planned: telemetry-logs-20280422.zip (log bundle), ir_evidence_index.csv (index).

If you need an immediate escalation to legal or security contacts, tell me who to loop in. We’ll include a concise postmortem once we complete validation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: planned (telemetry-logs-20280422.zip, ir_evidence_index.csv)

Thanks for the quick notice. We didn’t see direct customer-facing errors in our monitoring dashboards for that window, but a few internal jobs that rely on background inference batches showed delayed completion timestamps (we’ve opened a ticket internally to correlate).

Confirmed: we are available for the 20:00 UTC call. Priya and I will join. We’d like the preserved evidence to include any audit logs tied to API keys used by our integration (key fk_78b2) and any outbound HTTP 5xxs in that timeframe.

Also, please include a CSV mapping of request IDs to our customer request IDs where possible — that will speed our triage.

Appreciate the transparency.
Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@pinebrook.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@pinebrook.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Apr 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-incident summary: telemetry gap (2028-04-21T22:00:00Z — 2028-04-22T01:00:00Z) & deliverables

Alex/Priya —

Thanks again for joining the call Monday. Attached is a short post-incident summary and the evidence bundle. Key points first:

Root cause (summary):
- A transient configuration regression in the logging aggregator caused a shard rebalancing event that briefly dropped ~3 hours of write activity into the central log store. The aggregation worker retried and ultimately re-ingested ~86% of events; remaining gaps correlated with a subset of in-flight batch writes that were not reconcilable.

Customer impact:
- Pinebrook reported delayed internal job completion timestamps; we confirmed no public API 5xxs. No unauthorized data access was detected.

What we delivered:
- telemetry-logs-20280422.zip — contains proxy logs, request traces, and ingress/outgress HTTP logs for the window. (Secure link delivered to your SSO-enabled bucket.)
- ir_evidence_index.csv — mapping of Redwood request IDs to request timestamps and available Pinebrook correlation identifiers.
- postmortem-redwood-telemetry-gap-2028-04-25.pdf — formal write-up with timeline and remediation.

Actions completed / next steps:
- Mitigation: fixed the aggregator config and deployed a safety check to prevent the shard rebalancing regression from impacting writes (deployed 2028-04-22 03:15 UTC).
- Compensating control: added a short-term replication of write-ahead logs to a secondary store for higher durability (rolled out to prod 2028-04-23).
- Follow-up: we will run a 7-day telemetry integrity check and share the results (ETA: 2028-05-02).

Retention: per your ask we’ve preserved the evidence for 180 days; legal has been notified.

Attachments: telemetry-logs-20280422.zip, ir_evidence_index.csv, postmortem-redwood-telemetry-gap-2028-04-25.pdf

If you’d like a cleaned, redacted set for internal audit consumption (PII removed), Lauren will produce that and share a separate link.

Thanks — I’ll leave the thread open for any follow-up and will convert the postmortem into the shared runbook if any of the controls become permanent.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
